$comment: Whether a failed attempt is retried, as every implementation of the retry predicate must answer it: the dispatcher's queue acts on the answer, and a worker reports it on job:fail as willRetry, so the two must never disagree. A retry is allowed exactly when failureClass is not "deterministic" and retryCount < maxRetries, on the record before the failure is applied (docs/protocol/JOBS.md, Retries). TypeScript (packages/jobs: willRetryAfter) runs every case and fails on any difference. `failureClass` absent means the failure was not classified. Add a case here before changing an implementation.

cases.why: a transient failure with budget left
an unclassified failure is treated as transient
an unclassified failure with the budget spent
a deterministic failure, whatever budget is left: the same request cannot succeed a second time
no retries were ever budgeted (a generation job)
budget left after an earlier retry
